title: ModernWPF UI Library
description: Modern styles and controls for your WPF applications.

title: Fluent XAML Theme Editor
description: This repo contains the full solution and source code to the Fluent XAML Theme Editor - a tool that helps demonstrate the flexibility of the Fluent Design System as well as supports the app development process by generating XAML markup for our ResourceDictionary framework used in Universal Windows Platform (UWP) applications.

title: Files is a file manager for Windows
description: Files is a file manager for Windows with a powerful yet intuitive design. It has features like multiple tabs, panes, columns, shell extensions in the context menu and tags.

title: Ambie
description: Ambie is an app that plays white noise and nature sounds to help you focus, sleep, and unwind. For many people, having background noise while working on a task helps with concentration. Ambie has a good starting selection of built-in sounds such as rain and beach waves that help you. These can also be used to help you sleep, relax, and de-stress. For instance, those with tinnitus and anxiety have reached out saying Ambie has helped them. And if you download Ambie from the Microsoft Store, you'll get access to a catalogue of online sounds that you can download to expand your library.

title: ComputeSharp
description: ComputeSharp is a .NET library to run C# code in parallel on the GPU through DX12 and dynamically generated HLSL compute shaders. The available APIs let you access GPU devices, allocate GPU buffers and textures, move data between them and the RAM, write compute shaders entirely in C# and have them run on the GPU. The goal of this project is to make GPU computing easy to use for all .NET developers!

title: Money
description: Money is an outcome logging application written as UAP (UWP) to target both desktop and mobile Windows devices.

title: Material Design In XAML Toolkit
description: Comprehensive and easy to use Material Design theme and control library for the Windows desktop.

title: Nightingale REST Client Issues
description: Welcome to the official repo for Nightingale REST Client issue tracking. This is where people can report bugs, provide general feedback, and make feature requests.

title: DevToys
description: DevToys helps in daily tasks like formatting JSON, comparing text, testing RegExp. No need to use many untruthful websites to do simple tasks with your data. With Smart Detection, DevToys is able to detect the best tool that can treat the data you copied in the clipboard of your Windows. Compact overlay lets you keep the app in small and on top of other windows. Multiple instances of the app can be used at once.

title: WinUI Gallery
description: Shows all of the XAML UI components in an interactive format. This app is the interactive companion to the Fluent Design Guidelines and shows the usage of the WinUI APIs.

title: Rise-Media-Player
description: Rise Media Player brings all of your media to a whole new level. If it's videos, the music stored on your devices, discs or even your favourite streaming services; you'll love our player. One library for everything. Almost infinite customisability with settings that are second to none. Stream, browse and explore with Streaming Services - coming soon.
